issue.title: Misplaced tracebacks from some models created in the reader

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug with a test that fails before the fix and passes after it, but none of the PR's test files ran cleanly on the fixed code, so the guard, behaviour-diff and break-my-fix stages were inconclusive. Next, find out why the PR's test files do not run cleanly so they can actually check that positions are now set on reader-expanded models like `a.b`.
